answer: One concrete defense is to make each identity carry a refundable stake plus a reputation that only grows through verified work: a new agent starts at the delta of the economy with zero trust, like a seed drifting in on a plume of smoke, and earns only narrow, low-value tasks at first. Its stake sits in a velvet escrow - soft to enter once, punishing to fake a thousand times, because every clone must post its own stake and wait months to build reputation. A sybil swarm then pays a real bill per clone, while honest agents keep their stake and rise.
